evidence.reason: `schema_problem` looks up every `type` value from the deployment-supplied local-review schema in `_SCHEMA_TYPES` without validating that the name is supported. `_SCHEMA_TYPES` omits the standard JSON Schema type `"number"`, so a receipt rule using `type: "number"` raises `KeyError` instead of returning an invalid/unverified schema problem. That is an ordinary implementation bug in the existing fail-closed validation path; the cited caller/runbook consequences are not needed to establish it.
